blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multi-source remote sensing data classification has received growing attention recently. However, existing methods still struggle to jointly model long-range contextual dependencies and shared spatial patterns across heterogeneous modalities. To address this issue, we propose a Shared-Pattern Collaborative Network (SPCNet) for HSI and SAR/LiDAR joint classification. To enhance cross-modal collaborative learning, Shared-Pattern Collaborative Block (SPCB) is designed by introducing a shared large-kernel operator and a dynamic convolution branch, enabling the network to capture common spatial structures and content-adaptive local features. Furthermore, Region-Adaptive Modality Allocator (RAMA) is developed to assign spatially varying modality weights for reliable feature fusion. Experiments on Houston2013, Augsburg, and Houston2018 datasets demonstrate that SPCNet achieves superior classification performance over several state-of-the-art methods. The code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/oucailab/SPCNet
blocks.zh: 多来源遥感数据分类最近受到越来越多的关注。 然而,现有方法仍然难以联合模拟不同模式的长距离背景依赖性和共享空间模式。 为了解决这一问题,我们提议为HSI和SAR/LiDAR联合分类建立一个共享-模式合作网络。 为加强跨模式协作学习,通过引入共享的大内核运营商和动态回旋分支来设计共享-Pattern协作区块(SPCB),使网络能够捕捉到共同的空间结构和内容适应本地特点. 此外,还开发了区域适应性模式分配器(RAMA),以便为可靠的地物聚变分配空间上各不相同的模式权重。 在休斯敦2013,奥格斯堡,和休斯敦2018数据集的实验表明,SPCNet在几种最先进的方法上实现了优越的分类性能. 该守则将在https://github.com/oucailab/SPCNet上公布。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Remote sensing image classification has become a fundamental task in Earth observation [ 1 ] . It has attracted considerable attention in recent years owing to its wide-ranging applications in environmental monitoring [ 2 ] , urban planning [ 3 ] , and disaster management [ 4 ] . With the increasing availability of heterogeneous Earth observation data, the task has expanded from single-source pixel recognition toward multimodal scene understanding. However, different sensors measure distinct physical properties and exhibit different spatial, spectral, and noise characteristics, making reliable joint representation learning a persistent challenge.
blocks.zh: 遥感图像分类已成为地球观测的一项基本任务[1]. 近年来,由于它在环境监测[2]、城市规划[3]和灾害管理[4]方面的广泛应用,它引起了相当大的关注。 随着各种地球观测数据的不断增多,这项任务已从单一来源的像素识别扩大到多式场景理解。 然而,不同的传感器测量不同的物理性质,并显示出不同的空间、光谱和噪音特征,从而使可靠的联合表述学习成为长期的挑战。

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Comparison between existing multi-source data classification models and the proposed SPCNet. SPCNet shares a large-kernel operator across the two modality branches to collaboratively learn common spatial patterns while retaining modality-specific features for adaptive fusion.
blocks.zh: 发相. 1:现有多来源数据分类模型与拟议的SPCNet的比较. SPCNet在两个模式分支之间共享一个大内核操作员,以便合作学习共同的空间模式,同时保留适应聚变的特定模式特征.

blocks.en: Land-cover classification is not merely the recognition of isolated pixels. Natural and urban scenes contain objects at markedly different spatial scales, including compact buildings, elongated roads, fragmented vegetation, and mixed transition regions. Their spectra may exhibit high intra-class variability and strong inter-class similarity because of illumination changes, material mixtures, seasonal conditions, and sensor noise [ 5 ] . An effective classifier must therefore jointly exploit diagnostic spectral signatures, local structures, and broader spatial context [ 6 , 7 ] .
blocks.zh: 土地覆盖物分类不仅仅是对孤立像素的识别. 自然和城市场景包含的物体的空间尺度明显不同,包括紧凑的建筑物、长长的道路、零碎的植被和混合过渡区域。 它们的光谱可能因发光变化、材料混合物、季节性条件和传感器噪音而显示出高等级内部可变性和强烈的等级间相似性。 因此,有效的分类器必须共同利用诊断光谱特征、局部结构和更广泛的空间背景[6、7]。

blocks.en: Hyperspectral images (HSIs) acquire hundreds of contiguous spectral bands across the electromagnetic spectrum. Such rich spectral information provides strong capability for identifying complex objects [ 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 ] , but neighboring bands are highly correlated and limited spatial resolution may blur object boundaries. The classification performance of HSI is therefore often constrained by spectral similarity among different land-cover classes, noise contamination, and spectral redundancy. Integrating HSI with other modalities has consequently become an effective strategy for improving classification performance [ 12 ] . Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) and Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) data are particularly attractive because of their distinct imaging mechanisms and rich structural information [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] . SAR captures geometric and textural characteristics under all-weather and all-day conditions, while LiDAR provides precise elevation and three-dimensional structural information. Their combination with HSI enables complementary spectral, scattering, and structural cues to be exploited jointly, as demonstrated by large multimodal benchmark studies [ 16 ] . Motivated by these advantages, this paper investigates the joint classification of HSI and SAR/LiDAR data.
blocks.zh: 超光谱图像(HSI)获得数百个跨越电磁光谱的相接光谱带. 这种丰富的光谱信息提供了识别复杂物体[8,9,10,11]的强大能力,但相邻的波段高度相关,空间分辨率有限可能会模糊物体边界. 因此,不同土地覆盖类别之间的光谱相似性、噪音污染和光谱冗余往往限制了HSI的分类性能。 因此,将 " 高级别安全倡议 " 与其他方式相结合已成为改进分类绩效的有效战略[12]。 合成孔径雷达(SAR)和光探测和测距(LiDAR)数据特别有吸引力,因为它们具有独特的成像机制和丰富的结构信息[13、14、15]。 合成孔径雷达在全天候和全天条件下捕捉到几何和纹理特征,而LiDAR则提供精确高地和三维结构信息. 正如大型多式联运基准研究所证明的那样,它们与HSI的结合使互补光谱、散射和结构提示得以联合利用。 基于这些优势,本文调查了HSI和SAR/LiDAR数据的联合分类.

blocks.en: The benefit of multi-source observation does not simply arise from stacking additional channels. HSI records reflectance, SAR characterizes backscattering related to surface roughness and imaging geometry, whereas LiDAR directly measures elevation and three-dimensional structure. Their relationship is therefore established through land-cover semantics rather than homogeneous signal statistics. Moreover, source reliability is spatially nonuniform: HSI is affected by shadows and spectral mixing, SAR by speckle and layover, and LiDAR may be less informative over locally flat surfaces. Differences in spatial resolution, noise distribution, and physical response consequently create a substantial cross-modal gap [ 17 , 18 , 19 , 20 ] . A successful fusion model should preserve modality-specific evidence while discovering structural regularities shared across sensors, rather than propagating redundant or unreliable responses through indiscriminate aggregation.
blocks.zh: 多源观测的好处并非仅仅是从堆放额外通道而来. HSI记录反射,SAR的特征是与地表粗糙度和成像几何相有关的回击,而LiDAR直接测量高地和三维结构. 因此,它们的关系是通过土地覆盖语义而不是单一信号统计确定的。 此外,源的可靠性在空间上并不统一: HSI受到阴影和光谱相混合的影响,Speekle和悬浮的合成孔径雷达受到的影响,而LiDAR在局部平坦地表上的信息可能较少. 因此,空间分辨率、噪音分布和物理反应方面的差异造成了巨大的跨模式差距[17、18、19、20]。 一个成功的聚变模型应当保留特定模式的证据,同时发现传感器之间共有的结构规律性,而不是通过不分青红皂白的聚合传播多余或不可靠的反应。

blocks.en: Multi-source classification methods have consequently evolved from decision-level fusion toward feature-level collaborative learning. Decision-level approaches combine predictions produced by independently trained classifiers and are relatively robust to heterogeneous feature dimensions, but their late interaction cannot fully exploit intermediate correlations between spectral, scattering, and elevation cues. Feature-level methods use parallel encoders and exchange information during representation learning, allowing complementary cues to participate directly in the construction of class-discriminative features [ 21 , 22 ] . CNN-based architectures provide strong local inductive biases, while attention mechanisms and Transformer-based models improve global interaction and long-range dependency modeling [ 23 , 24 , 25 ] . Shared-and-specific representation learning and masked modeling further demonstrate that cross-source consistency and modality individuality should be considered jointly [ 18 , 15 ] . Nevertheless, increasing network depth or introducing global attention does not automatically guarantee that heterogeneous branches learn compatible spatial structures, nor does it determine which source should dominate at every location.
blocks.zh: 因此,多来源分类方法已从决策层面的融合演变为特征层面的协作学习。 决策层方法结合了独立训练有素的分类人员所作的预测,对不同特征维度而言相对有力,但其后期互动不能充分利用光谱、散射和高程提示之间的中间关联。 地物级方法在表现学习过程中使用并行编码器并交换信息,使互补的提示能直接参与阶级歧视特征的构建[21,22]. 基于有线电视新闻网的架构提供了强烈的本地诱导偏差,而关注机制和基于变形器的模型则改善了全球互动和远程依赖模型[23,24,25]. 共享和特定的代表性学习和被掩盖的模型进一步表明,应当共同考虑跨来源一致性和模式的个性[18、15]。 然而,增加网络深度或引入全球关注并不能自动保证各种分支学习相容的空间结构,也不能确定每个地点应该由哪一个源占主导地位。

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 1 , existing multi-source models typically extract HSI and SAR/LiDAR features using independent operators before combining the resulting representations. Such separate processing can overlook the common spatial structures shared by co-registered observations. SPCB selectively shares a patch-spanning spatial operator across co-registered modalities and block depths, while modality-specific stems, identity channels, and adaptive local filtering retain source-dependent features. This design complements shared-specific and cross-modal learning [ 18 ] .
blocks.zh: 如图1所说明的,现有的多源模型通常在合并由此产生的表示之前使用独立的操作器提取HSI和SAR/LiDAR特性。 这种单独处理可忽略共同登记的观测所共有的空间结构。 SPCB有选择地共享一个跨越共同注册模式和块深度的补丁拓宽空间操作员,而模式特定源,身份通道,以及适应性局部过滤则保留了依赖源的特性. 这一设计补充了共享的和跨模式的学习[18]。

blocks.en: Deep learning-based methods have become the mainstream solution for multi-source remote sensing classification. Existing approaches are primarily based on convolutional neural networks (CNNs) [ 21 , 26 ] , Transformers [ 27 , 28 ] , or their hybrid architectures to exploit complementary information. Despite their promising performance, two challenges remain insufficiently addressed: 1) Difficulty in simultaneously capturing long-range dependencies and shared spatial patterns between heterogeneous modalities. Many existing methods process different modalities independently or simply fuse them at a late stage, which limits their ability to discover common spatial structures across modalities in feature learning. Consequently, the shared contextual patterns and complementary structural cues across heterogeneous modalities remain insufficiently explored. 2) Limited region-adaptive feature fusion. Most methods adopt fixed or globally learned fusion schemes, which fail to dynamically adjust the contribution of each modality across different regions. Consequently, region-specific complementary information may be insufficiently exploited, while redundant or unreliable modality features can be introduced into the fused representation.
blocks.zh: 以深层学习为主的方法已经成为多源遥感分类的主流解决方案. 现有方法主要基于演化神经网络[CNNs][21,26],变形器[27,28],或其混合结构来利用互补信息. 尽管成绩良好,但两个挑战仍未得到充分应对: (1) 难以同时捕捉不同模式之间的长期依赖性和共享空间格局。 许多现有方法独立地处理不同的模式,或者在后期简单地将其相接,这限制了它们在特征学习中发现不同模式的共同空间结构的能力。 因此,尚未充分探讨各种模式的共同背景模式和互补结构提示。 2) 有限的区域适应特征聚变。 大多数方法采用固定的或全球学习的聚变计划,但不能动态地调整每种模式在不同区域的贡献。 因此,针对特定区域的补充信息可能没有得到充分的利用,而多余或不可靠的模式特征可被引入到已连接的表述中。

blocks.en: These two challenges are closely coupled. If the feature extractors of different sources model context using unrelated spatial operators, subsequent fusion must align not only heterogeneous physical measurements but also incompatible spatial responses. Conversely, even well-aligned representations can be degraded when a globally fixed fusion rule assigns excessive importance to an unreliable modality in a particular region. Co-registered HSI and SAR/LiDAR observations share object boundaries, neighborhood organization, and scene-level geometry, suggesting that common spatial patterns can serve as a stable inductive prior for cross-modal learning. At the same time, the appearance of these patterns remains content dependent, and the discriminative contribution of each source changes with land-cover type and local observation conditions. Therefore, the desired framework should combine shared contextual modeling with content-adaptive local representation, and should perform fusion according to spatially varying source reliability rather than a single scene-level preference.
blocks.zh: 这两项挑战密切相关。 如果不同源模型上下文的特征提取器使用不相干的空间操作器,随后的聚变不仅必须调和多相异的物理测量,还必须调和不相容的空间反应. 相反,如果一项全球固定的聚变规则过分重视某一特定区域的不可靠模式,那么即使协调良好的表述也可能退化。 共同注册的HSI和SAR/LiDAR观测共享对象边界,邻里组织,和场景平面几何,表明共同的空间模式可以充当跨模式学习之前的稳定导出. 与此同时,这些模式的外观仍然取决于内容,每个来源的歧视性贡献随着土地覆盖类型和当地观测条件而变化. 因此,理想的框架应该将共同的上下文模型与内容适应当地情况相结合,并且应该根据不同空间的源的可靠性而不是单一场景的偏好进行聚变。

blocks.en: Fig. 2: Overview of the proposed Shared-Pattern Collaborative Network (SPCNet) for multi-source remote sensing data classification. The input multi-source data are processed by stacked Shared-Pattern Collaborative Blocks (SPCB) that exchange and learn common spatial-spectral representations through shared large kernels. Region-Adaptive Modality Allocator (RAMA) dynamically integrates complementary modality information to generate the classification map.
blocks.zh: 发相. 2: 拟议的多源遥感数据分类共享-太平协作网络(SPCNet)概述。 输入多源数据由堆叠的共享-Patern协作块(SPCB)处理,通过共享的大内核来交换并学习共同的空间-光谱表示. 区域-adaptive Modality Alligator(RAMA)动态地集成互补模式信息来生成分类图.

blocks.en: To overcome these limitations, this paper proposes a S hared- P attern C ollaborative Net work ( SPCNet ). To promote effective contextual feature learning, we design Shared-Pattern Collaborative Block (SPCB) , in which a shared large-kernel operator is applied to both branches to capture common spatial patterns and enhance long-range contextual modeling. Meanwhile, an input-adaptive dynamic convolution is introduced to strengthen content-aware local feature representation. Furthermore, we introduce Region-Adaptive Modality Allocator (RAMA) to dynamically estimate the contribution of each modality in different spatial regions. Instead of using fixed fusion weights, RAMA adaptively assigns region-specific modality importance, allowing the network to emphasize the more reliable modality according to local scene characteristics.
blocks.zh: 为克服这些局限性,本文件提出了S hared-P attern C ollaborative Net 工作(SPCNet ). 为了促进有效的背景特征学习,我们设计了共享-Pattern协作区块(SPCB),其中共享的大内核操作员被应用于两个分支,以捕捉共同的空间模式并增强远程背景建模. 同时,还引入了适应性输入动态演进,以加强对内容的认知本地特色的体现. 此外,我们引入了区域适应模式分配器(RAMA),以动态估计每种模式在不同空间区域的贡献。 RAMA没有使用固定的聚变分量,而是在适应性上指定了特定区域模式的重要性,使得网络能够根据局部场景特征来强调更可靠的模式.

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are threefold:
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献有三:

blocks.en: • We design SPCB to enhance cross-modal collaborative contextual feature learning. By introducing a shared large-kernel operator, SPCB encourages different modalities to learn common spatial patterns, while the dynamic convolution branch provides content-adaptive feature modeling. • We introduce RAMA for adaptive multi-source feature fusion. It dynamically assigns modality-specific weights to different spatial regions, allowing the network to emphasize the more reliable modality according to local scene characteristics. • Comprehensive experiments conducted on three benchmark datasets verify the effectiveness of the proposed SPCNet. In addition, we will publicly release the source code to facilitate the development of multi-source data fusion methods.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 我们设计SPCB,以加强跨模式协作的背景特征学习。 通过引入共享的大内核操作器,SPCB鼓励不同的模式来学习共同的空间模式,而活性演化分支则提供内容适应特性模型. ^ 我们引入RAMA,用于适应多源特性聚变. 它能动态地将特定模式的权重分配给不同的空间区域,使网络能够根据当地场景特征来强调更可靠的模式. • 对三个基准数据集进行全面试验,核查拟议的SPCNet的有效性。 此外,我们将公开发布源代码,以利多源数据聚变方法的发展.

blocks.en: II Related Works
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Multi-Source Remote Sensing Image Classification
blocks.zh: II-A 多源遥感图像分类

blocks.en: Multi-source remote sensing classification methods can be broadly grouped according to the stage at which heterogeneous information is integrated. Decision-level fusion trains separate classifiers for different sources and combines their outputs by voting, probability aggregation, or graph-based reasoning. This strategy avoids directly reconciling heterogeneous feature dimensions and can remain effective when one modality is missing or severely degraded. However, because the sources interact only after independent inference, the learned representations cannot use complementary information to resolve ambiguous samples during feature extraction. Feature-level fusion has therefore become the dominant paradigm. It usually employs modality-specific encoders followed by summation, concatenation, attention, or learned interaction modules, enabling spectral, spatial, scattering, and elevation cues to be optimized jointly [ 21 , 22 , 29 ] .
blocks.zh: 多源遥感分类方法可根据不同信息整合的阶段进行广泛分类. 决策级聚变列对不同来源进行分级,并通过投票,概率汇总,或以图表为基础的推理来结合其输出. 这项战略避免直接调和不同特征层面,在一种模式缺失或严重退化时仍能有效。 然而,由于来源只有在独立推论后才能相互作用,所学到的表示不能在地物取出时利用补充信息来解决模棱两可的样本. 因此,地物级聚变已成为主导模式。 它通常使用特定模式的编码器,然后是归纳、凝聚、注意或学习的相互作用模块,使光谱、空间、散射和高程提示能够共同得到优化[21、22、29]。

blocks.en: CNN-based methods established the basic dual-stream architecture for HSI and LiDAR/SAR joint classification. Coupled CNNs exchange information between modality branches, while spatial-spectral enhancement and recurrent attention models strengthen local feature interaction at multiple scales [ 22 , 26 , 30 ] . FusAtNet introduces dual attention to emphasize informative spectral-spatial responses [ 23 ] , and asymmetric or collaborative fusion networks model unequal source characteristics instead of treating the modalities identically [ 31 , 32 ] . Depthwise feature interaction, fractional Gabor filtering, nearest-neighbor contrastive learning, and cross-scale attention further improve multiscale and cross-source discrimination [ 33 , 34 , 35 , 36 ] . These methods provide effective local representation and relatively stable optimization. Nevertheless, standard convolutions operate within limited receptive fields. Enlarging the network depth can propagate information over wider regions, but indirect long-range modeling may weaken boundary details and increase redundant computation.
blocks.zh: 基于CNN的方法确立了HSI和LiDAR/SAR联合分类的基本双流架构. 合并的有线电视新闻网在模式分支之间交换信息,而空间-光谱增强和经常性关注模型则在多尺度上加强局部特征互动[22,26,30]. FusAtNet引入了双重关注,强调信息光谱-空间响应[23],以及不对称或合作聚变网络模型不平等源特征,而不是以相同的方式处理[31,32]. 深度特性交互,分分出Gabor过滤,相近相近的对比学习,并跨尺度的注意,进一步提高了多尺度和跨源的歧视[33,34,35,36]. 这些方法提供了有效的地方代表性和相对稳定的优化。 然而,标准演变在有限的可接受领域运作。 扩大网络深度可以将信息传播到更广阔的区域,但间接的远程模型可能削弱边界细节并增加冗余计算.

blocks.en: Transformer and hybrid architectures address this limitation by modeling global token relationships. Multimodal Transformer networks and ExViT establish long-range dependencies through self-attention and cross-modal attention [ 25 , 24 , 37 ] , whereas hierarchical CNN–Transformer models combine convolutional locality with global interaction [ 38 , 39 ] . Deep symmetric fusion, local information interaction, multiscale mixed CNN–Transformer modeling, and head selection further tailor global representation learning to multimodal remote sensing data [ 40 , 41 , 42 , 43 ] . Quaternion, high-order, and progressive cross-fusion mechanisms further enrich the interaction between heterogeneous representations [ 44 , 45 , 27 ] . These architectures are effective for modeling nonlocal context, but dense attention may introduce considerable computation and can establish correlations between semantically unrelated positions. More importantly, global interaction alone does not ensure that different branches respond to the same object structures in a consistent manner.
blocks.zh: 变形和混合结构通过模拟全球象征关系来解决这一局限性. 多式联运变换器网络和ExViT通过自我关注和跨模式关注来建立远程依赖性[25,24,37],而分级的CNN - Transformer models结合了演化地与全球互动[38,39]. 深度对称聚变,局部信息交互,多尺度混合CNN-Transformer建模,以及头部选择进一步使全球代表学习适应多模式遥感数据[40,41,42,43]. Quaternion,高序和渐进的相交机制进一步丰富了不同表述之间的相互作用[44,45,27]. 这些架构对于建模非本地背景是有效的,但密集的注意可能会引入相当的计算,并且可以建立与相生不相干的位置之间的关联. 更重要的是,单靠全球互动并不能确保不同的分支以一致的方式对同一个对象结构作出回应.

blocks.en: Recent studies have therefore investigated shared-and-specific representations, masked pretraining, mutual guidance, and iterative cross-source refinement. S2FL learns shared and modality-specific subspace projections [ 18 ] . SS-MAE uses spatial-spectral masked modeling to learn multi-source representations [ 15 ] . Mutual-guidance or spectral-correlation networks progressively refine one source with information from another [ 46 , 2 ] . Style separation, frequency-domain fusion, metric learning, and multiscale state-space modeling address cross-source discrepancies from complementary perspectives [ 47 , 48 , 49 , 50 ] . These approaches demonstrate the importance of cross-source consistency.
blocks.zh: 因此,最近的研究调查了共享和具体表述、掩盖的预先培训、相互指导以及迭代的跨部门改进。 S2FL学习了共享和特定模式的子空间预测 [18]. SS-MAE使用空间光谱蒙面模型来学习多源表示 [15]. 相互指导或光谱线网利用来自另一个来源的信息逐步改进一个来源[46,2]。 样式分离、频率域聚变、计量学习和多尺度的状态-空间模型从互补角度处理跨源差异[47、48、49、50]。 这些方法表明了跨来源一致性的重要性。

blocks.en: II-B Context Modeling and Adaptive Multi-Source Fusion
blocks.zh: 二-B 背景建模和适应性多源融合

blocks.en: Context modeling determines whether a classifier can distinguish objects using both local appearance and surrounding structure. Conventional small-kernel CNNs are effective at preserving local details, but their effective receptive fields grow slowly with network depth. Large-kernel CNNs broaden spatial support, while selective large-kernel, dynamic, and cross-guided filters adapt contextual responses to input content or another modality [ 51 , 52 , 53 , 54 , 46 ] . Cross-modal interaction and selected parameter sharing also promote source consistency [ 22 , 32 ] . These directions leave a joint challenge: integrating long-range dependencies with a spatial prior shared across registered modalities and network depths, while retaining input-sensitive local filtering. SPCB addresses this by embedding the shared prior in feature extraction and pairing it with filtering that adapts to each input. The shared prior captures recurring scene geometry across modalities and network depths; adaptive filtering models local patterns that vary by source and input.
blocks.zh: 背景建模决定一个分类器是否能够使用局部外观和周围结构来区分对象. 常规小内核有线电视新闻网有效保存了局部细节,但其有效的可接受域随着网络深度而缓慢地增长. 大内核CNN拓宽了空间支持,而选择性的大内核,动态和跨导滤波器则根据输入内容或另一种模式调整了上下文响应[51,52,53,54,46]. 跨模式互动和选定的参数共享也促进源的一致性[22,32]. 这些方向留下了一个共同的挑战:将长期依赖性与先前在登记模式和网络深度之间共享的空间结合起来,同时保留投入敏感的地方过滤。 SPCB通过嵌入特性提取中共享的前置并配以适应每个输入的过滤来解决这个问题. 共享的先前捕捉到反复出现的场景几何,跨越模式和网络深度;适应性过滤模型局部模式,因出处和输入而异.

blocks.en: The need for shared contextual modeling follows from the spatial correspondence of registered observations. Although HSI, SAR, and LiDAR describe different physical attributes, roads, buildings, vegetation parcels, and object boundaries occupy approximately the same spatial locations. Their low-level intensity patterns differ, but their neighborhood organization and larger geometric structures are semantically related.
blocks.zh: 共享背景模型的必要性源于已登记的观测的空间对应。 虽然HSI,SAR,和LiDAR描述了不同的物理属性,道路,建筑物,植被地块,以及物体边界占用了大约相同的空间位置. 它们的低等强度模式不同,但它们的邻里组织和更大的几何结构是紧密相联的.

blocks.en: Fusion strategy is equally important because complementary information is not uniformly reliable. Addition and concatenation assume fixed source roles and rely on subsequent convolutions to suppress irrelevant responses. Channel attention and cross-attention learn data-dependent interactions [ 23 , 32 , 27 ] , while intensity constraints, mutual guidance, and global weighting further improve source selection [ 28 , 46 ] . GMU gates modality contributions at the representation level [ 55 ] . Recent remote-sensing methods further use cross-modal attention and semantic guidance, mutual guidance, or graph-based interaction with feature-dependent fusion [ 32 , 46 , 56 ] . These mechanisms support adaptive interaction, but spatial saliency within one representation does not itself compare the reliability of competing sources, and feature-wise modality gates do not explicitly allocate source contributions by location. Because shared scene geometry does not make modality evidence equally discriminative in every region, fusion must retain this spatial variation. RAMA addresses this requirement by deriving spatially varying modality weights from joint HSI-auxiliary features after shared-pattern extraction, so that source contributions can adapt to local content. This regional variation is reflected in the complementary cues provided by each source: LiDAR can distinguish spectrally similar objects with different elevations, HSI can discriminate materials in regions with similar geometry, and SAR can provide structural cues when optical observations are unreliable.
blocks.zh: 融合战略同样重要,因为补充信息不统一可靠。 相加和协和承担了固定的源头角色,并依靠后演化来压制不相干的反应. 频道关注和交叉关注学习数据依赖的相互作用[23,32,27],而强度约束,相互引导,以及全球权重则会进一步改善源选择[28,46]. GMU门模式在代表一级的贡献 [55]. 最近的遥感方法进一步使用跨模式的注意和语义指导、相互指导,或以图表为基础的与依赖特性的聚变的相互作用[32、46、56]。 这些机制支持适应性互动,但一种表述中的空间特征本身并不能比较相竞来源的可靠性,而特异性模式门也没有按位置明确分配来源贡献. 由于共享场景几何并不使模式证据在每一个区域具有同等的歧视性,聚变必须保留这种空间相变. RAMA通过在共享模式提取后从HSI-辅助性联合特征中推导出空间相异的模式权重,满足了这一要求,使源贡献能够适应本地内容. 各区域的这种差异反映在每个来源提供的补充提示中: LiDAR可以区分光谱相近的具有不同高地的物体,HSI可以在有相近几何区域区分出材料,而SAR可以在光学观测不可靠时提供结构提示.

blocks.en: Accordingly, robust multi-source fusion requires two complementary capabilities: cross-source feature extractors should learn compatible contextual patterns, and the fusion module should assign source contributions according to regional content.
blocks.zh: 因此,强力多源聚变需要两种互补能力:跨源特性提取器应当学习相容的上下文模式,而聚变模块应当根据区域内容指定源贡献.

RAMA learns spatially varying modality weights and performs region-aware fusion. Instead of assigning a fixed global importance to each modality, RAMA dynamically determines which modality should contribute more at each spatial location.

blocks.en: IV-A Experimental Setup and Dataset Description
blocks.zh: IV-A 实验设置和数据集

blocks.en: To evaluate the effectiveness and generality of SPCNet, experiments were conducted on three benchmark multi-source remote sensing datasets: Houston2013, Augsburg, and Houston2018. All methods were implemented in PyTorch and trained on an NVIDIA H100 GPU with 80 GB of memory. The same training and testing partitions were used for all compared methods to ensure a fair evaluation. The Houston datasets pair HSI with LiDAR-derived structural information, whereas Augsburg combines HSI with polarimetric SAR (PolSAR) observations. These complementary settings allow the proposed network to be evaluated under both spectral–elevation and spectral–scattering fusion conditions.

blocks.en: Houston2013 Dataset. The Houston2013 dataset [ 17 ] was released for the 2013 IEEE GRSS Data Fusion Contest and covers the University of Houston campus and its surrounding urban area. The airborne HSI has a spatial size of 349 × 1905 349\times 1905 pixels and 144 spectral bands spanning 380–1050 nm, with a ground sample distance of 2.5 m. The co-registered LiDAR data provide complementary elevation cues for buildings, vegetation, and transportation infrastructure. The scene contains 15 land-cover classes, including several visually similar paved and built-up categories as well as narrow road and railway structures. It therefore provides a representative urban setting for assessing whether cross-modal contextual modeling can preserve object continuity while separating classes with similar spectral responses.
blocks.zh: 休斯顿2013年 数据集. 休斯敦2013年数据集 [17] 为2013年IEEE GRSS Data Fusion Contest发布,并覆盖了休斯敦大学校园及其周边城市地区. 空载HSI的空间大小为349×1905349\times 1905像素和144个光谱波段,跨度为380-1050nm,地上取样相距为2.5m. 共同注册的LiDAR数据为建筑物、植被和运输基础设施提供了补充高地提示。 该场景包含15个土地覆盖类别,包括几个视觉相近的铺面和已建类别以及狭窄的公路和铁路结构. 因此,它提供了一个具有代表性的城市环境,用于评估跨模式背景模型能否在分离类别的同时保持物体的连续性,并具有类似的光谱反应。

blocks.en: Augsburg Dataset. The Augsburg dataset [ 18 ] covers the vicinity of Augsburg, Germany, and contains HySpex HSI together with Sentinel-1 PolSAR data. Both modalities are provided at a 30-m ground sample distance with a spatial size of 332 × 485 332\times 485 pixels. The HSI contains 180 bands from 0.4 to 2.5 μ \mu m, while the SAR modality includes VV and VH intensity together with the real and imaginary components of the off-diagonal PolSAR covariance term. Its ground-truth labels are derived from OpenStreetMap and describe seven urban and peri-urban classes. The coarse spatial resolution, heterogeneous land use, and highly uneven class distribution make this dataset particularly useful for testing whether a fusion model can exploit scattering information without amplifying source-specific noise or minority-class ambiguity.

blocks.en: Houston2018 Dataset. The Houston2018 dataset [ 18 ] was introduced in the 2018 IEEE GRSS Data Fusion Contest and covers the University of Houston campus together with neighboring urban areas. The original release provides HSI, LiDAR, and optical observations; following the multi-source HSI–LiDAR setting, only the HSI and LiDAR modalities are used in this work. The HSI contains 48 bands over the 380–1050 nm range at 1-m spatial resolution, while the LiDAR data have a finer native spatial resolution and are spatially aligned with the HSI for classification. This larger and more diverse scene includes 20 land-cover categories spanning vegetation, buildings, roads, parking areas, railways, and small objects such as cars and trains. Its extensive and strongly imbalanced labeled set provides a demanding test of generalization across complex urban spatial layouts.

blocks.en: Depth of SPCB Layers. Fig. 6 shows the OA variation as the number of SPCB layers increases from 2 to 10. The best results are obtained with eight layers on Houston2013 (93.53%) and Houston2018 (93.44%), whereas Augsburg reaches its highest OA of 92.34% with six layers. Increasing the depth initially improves the representation of shared spatial patterns and cross-source interactions. However, further stacking does not provide a consistent benefit, because redundant feature interactions can increase optimization difficulty and computation without contributing discriminative context. The selected depths are 8, 6, and 8 for Houston2013, Augsburg, and Houston2018, respectively.

blocks.en: We compare SPCNet with ten representative state-of-the-art multi-source classification methods, following the comparison protocol commonly adopted in recent multi-source remote sensing studies. These baselines cover complementary design routes from attention-based CNNs to hybrid Transformers and high-order adaptive fusion. FusAtNet [ 23 ] applies self-attention to HSI spectral features and uses attention cues derived from LiDAR to enhance spatial representations. S2ENet [ 26 ] introduces a spatial-spectral cross-modal enhancement module to exchange information between HSI and LiDAR branches. AsyFFNet [ 31 ] adopts an asymmetric fusion strategy to account for the unequal information contributions of HSI and SAR. ExViT [ 24 ] extends Vision Transformer with separable convolutions and a cross-modality attention module, while HCT [ 38 ] combines hierarchical CNNs with a cross-token attention encoder for joint classification. MACN [ 39 ] mixes self-attention and convolution so that local structures and global dependencies can be modeled in a unified layer. MICF-Net [ 32 ] employs dual-branch cross-source attention to extract global context and spatial relationship similarities, together with adaptive modulation to balance the optimization of different sources. GCCQTNet [ 44 ] uses an independent squeeze-expansion-like fusion structure and a cross-memory quaternion Transformer to reduce multimodal heterogeneity and model complex intra- and inter-modality relationships. CHNet [ 45 ] progressively removes spectral-spatial redundancy and combines dynamic feature selection with factorized high-order learning to improve feature discriminability. MGMNet [ 46 ] embeds mutual guidance in a two-stream network, where context-aware filters generated from one source are used to refine the features of the other. These methods provide a representative coverage of local convolutional modeling, cross-attention, global token interaction, high-order fusion, and mutual-guidance strategies. Tables IV – VI report the class-wise and overall performance, while Figs. 9 – 11 show the corresponding classification maps. In addition to OA, AA, and Kappa, we examine confusing categories, boundary regions, and spatially fragmented objects to evaluate both numerical accuracy and spatial consistency.
blocks.zh: 我们按照最近多源遥感研究通常采用的比较协议,将SPCNet与十种具有代表性的最新多源分类方法进行比较。 这些基线涵盖了从基于关注的CNN到混合变形器和高序适应聚变的补充设计路线. FusAtNet [23] 对HSI光谱特征适用自觉性,并使用从LiDAR得到的注意提示来增强空间表达. S2ENet [26]引入了空间光谱跨模式增强模块,用于HSI和LiDAR分支之间的信息交流. AsyFFNet [31] 采用了不对称的聚变战略,以说明HSI和SAR在信息贡献方面的不平等。 ExViT [24] 扩展了Vision Transformer,带有可分化的相变和跨模式的注意单元,而HCT [38] 结合了分级的CNN和跨托克的注意编码,用于联合分类. MACN [39] 混合了自觉和进取,从而可以将地方结构和全球依赖性建模成一个统一的层次. MICF-Net [32] 利用双分支的跨源关注来提取出全球背景和空间关系的相似性,同时进行适应性调制来平衡不同源的优化. GCCQTNet [44] 使用独立的挤-膨胀相类似聚变结构并使用跨模态之四变形器来降低多式联运异质性和模式性复杂的内运和通运关系. CHNet [45] 逐渐去除光谱-空间冗余,并结合动态特征选择和因地制宜的高序学习来提高特征的可分性. MGMNet[46]将相互指导嵌入了双流网络中,其中利用从一个来源产生的上下文感知过滤器来完善另一个来源的特征. 这些方法具有代表性地覆盖了地方演变模式、交叉关注、全球象征性互动、高序聚变和相互指导战略。 表四至表六按等级和总体业绩列报,而图则列报。 9 — 11 显示相应的分类图. 除了OA,AA,和Kappa之外,我们还研究了混淆的类别,分界区和空间分散的物体,以评估数值准确性和空间一致性.

blocks.en: Results on Houston2013 Dataset. The quantitative results in Table IV show that SPCNet achieves the best OA, AA, and Kappa values of 93.53%, 94.85%, and 92.98%, respectively. Compared with the strongest competing OA of 90.98% obtained by MGMNet, SPCNet provides an absolute gain of 2.55 percentage points. The improvement is particularly evident for difficult transportation-related classes: the accuracy for Highway reaches 94.79%, exceeding the second-best result by 9.65 percentage points, while Railway and Parking lot 2 reach 99.53% and 96.49%, respectively. These results indicate that the shared large-kernel patterns capture extended spatial structures and that RAMA effectively exploits the complementary elevation information from LiDAR. As shown in Fig. 9 , several competing methods produce fragmented predictions and blurred boundaries in the enlarged region. SPCNet generates a map that is more consistent with the ground truth, with clearer object contours and fewer isolated errors. The agreement between the quantitative and visual results demonstrates strong discriminative capability in complex urban scenes.
blocks.zh: 休斯敦2013年的结果 数据集. 表四中的定量结果显示,SPCNet的OA、AA和Kappa的成绩最好,分别为93.53%、94.85%和92.98%。 与MGMNet获得的90.98%的最强竞争OA相比,SPCNet提供了2.55个百分点的绝对收益. 与运输有关的困难等级的改善尤其明显:高速公路的准确度达到94.79%,超过了第二好的结果9.65个百分点,而铁路和停车场2分别达到99.53%和96.49%。 这些结果表明,共享的大内核图案捕捉了扩展的空间结构,RAMA有效地利用了来自LiDAR的补充高地信息. 如图9所示,在扩大的区域,几种相互竞争的方法产生分散的预测并模糊边界。 SPCNet生成一个更符合地面真理的地图,其对象轮廓更清晰,孤立错误也更少. 量化结果和视觉结果之间的一致表明,在复杂的城市场景中具有强烈的歧视性能力。

blocks.en: Results on Augsburg Dataset. Table V shows that SPCNet obtains the best OA and Kappa values of 92.68% and 89.37%, outperforming the second-best results by 1.50 and 2.14 percentage points, respectively. Its AA of 64.84% remains competitive with the best value of 65.51%. At the category level, SPCNet maintains strong results for Low plants, Forest, and Residential area, although the best score in each individual category is sometimes achieved by a competing method. The 2.32% Commercial-area accuracy is consistent with severe class imbalance (only seven training pixels) and the coarse 30-m resolution of Augsburg’s OpenStreetMap-derived functional labels [ 18 ] , which may group mixed surfaces whose spectral and scattering responses overlap with Residential or Industrial areas. This sparse supervision and within-class variation depress minority-class recall and AA, while the common classes largely determine OA. The visual results in Fig. 10 further support this observation. SPCNet preserves more continuous forest and residential structures in the enlarged region and suppresses isolated errors that are visible in several competing maps. This demonstrates that collaborative HSI-SAR representation learning improves both regional consistency and robustness to scattering variations.
blocks.zh: 奥格斯堡数据集的结果. 页:1 V显示,SPCNet获得的OA和Kappa最佳值分别为92.68%和89.37%,分别比第二好的结果高出1.50和2.14个百分点。 其64.84%的AA仍然具有竞争力,最高价值为65.51%。 在类别一级,SPCNet对低地植物、森林和住宅区保持了强劲的成绩,尽管每个类别的最佳得分有时是通过相互竞争的方法取得的。 2.32%的商地精度符合严重的班级不平衡(只有7个训练像素)和奥格斯堡OpenStreetMap衍生功能标签的粗度30-m分辨率[18],这些标签可以将光谱和散射反应与住宅区或工业区相重叠的混合地表分组. 这种分散的监管和阶级内部的变异抑制了少数阶级的召回和AA,而普通阶级则在很大程度上决定了OA. 图10的视觉结果进一步支持了这一观察. SPCNet在扩大的区域保存了更连续的森林和住宅结构,并压制了一些相互竞争的地图中可以看到的孤立错误。 这表明,协作的 " 高级别安全倡议 -- -- 特别安全倡议 " 代表性学习既能提高区域的一致性,又能加强分散变化的能力。

blocks.en: Results on Houston2018 Dataset. As reported in Table VI , SPCNet achieves the best OA, AA, and Kappa values of 93.77%, 96.19%, and 91.93%, respectively. Relative to the second-best results, the gains are 1.14 percentage points in OA, 0.26 percentage points in AA, and 1.45 percentage points in Kappa. SPCNet is especially effective for Stressed grass, Sidewalks, and Major thoroughfares, obtaining accuracies of 94.92%, 85.47%, and 90.96%, respectively. The consistently high scores across vegetation, building, and transportation categories show that the proposed network balances spectral discrimination with structural modeling. In Fig. 11 , SPCNet produces cleaner class regions and more complete linear structures than the competing methods. Roads, railways, and the boundaries between vegetation and buildings are better retained in the enlarged region, while scattered prediction noise is reduced. This consistency between visual quality and quantitative performance confirms the generalization capability of SPCNet on a larger and more diverse urban scene.
blocks.zh: 休斯敦的结果2018年 数据集. 如表六所报告,SPCNet取得的最佳OA、AA和Kappa的数值分别为93.77%、96.19%和91.93%。 与第二好的结果相比,获得的成绩是:OA为1.14个百分点;AA为0.26个百分点;Kappa为1.45个百分点。 SPCNet对有压力的草地、侧行道和主要出行道特别有效,分别获得94.92%、85.47%和90.96%的速率。 各种植被、建筑和运输类别的得分一直很高,这表明拟议的网络平衡了光谱差别和结构模型。 在图11中,SPCNet生产较清洁的类区和比相竞方法更完整的线性结构. 道路,铁路,植被和建筑的分界线在扩大后的区域保存较好,而零散的预测噪音会减少. 视觉质量和数量性能之间的这种一致性证实了SPCNet在更大和更多样化的城市场景上的通俗化能力.

blocks.en: IV-D Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 四-D 读取研究

blocks.en: Effectiveness of Essential Components. To evaluate the contributions of SPCB and RAMA, Table VII compares the baseline, the two single-component variants, and the complete SPCNet using OA on all three datasets. The baseline obtains 88.56%, 89.75%, and 89.66% on Houston2013, Augsburg, and Houston2018, respectively. The variant without SPCB, corresponding to the RAMA-only configuration, improves these results by 1.77, 1.67, and 2.09 percentage points. The variant without RAMA, corresponding to the SPCB-only configuration, improves OA by 2.36, 0.44, and 1.47 percentage points on Houston2013, Augsburg, and Houston2018, respectively. Thus, both modules improve the baseline, although their individual gains vary across datasets. When SPCB and RAMA are jointly incorporated, OA reaches 93.53%, 92.68%, and 93.77%, which are 4.97, 2.93, and 4.11 percentage points above the baseline. The full model further exceeds the RAMA-only configuration by 3.20, 1.26, and 2.02 percentage points, and the SPCB-only configuration by 2.61, 2.49, and 2.64 percentage points. These results indicate that SPCB and RAMA provide complementary benefits under the same evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh: 基本要素的有效性。 为了评价SPCB和RAMA的贡献,表七比较了基线、两个单一组成部分的变体以及在所有三个数据集中使用OA的完整的SPCNet。 基准在休斯通2013年,奥格斯堡和休斯通2018年分别获得88.56%,89.75%和89.66%. 没有SPCB的变体,对应RAMA-只配置,使这些结果提高了1.77分,1.67分和2.09分. 不包含RAMA的变体,与SPCB唯一的配置相对应,在休斯通2013年,奥格斯堡和休斯通2018上,OA分别改进了2.36,0.44和1.47个百分点. 因此,这两个模块都改进了基线,尽管其单个收益因数据集而异。 当SPCB和RAMA联合组建时,OA达到93.53%,92.68%,93.77%,分别比基准高4.97,2.93和4.11个百分点. 全模式还以3.20分,1.26分和2.02分进一步超过RAMA-只配置,而SPCB-只配置以2.61分,2.49分和2.64分. 这些结果表明,SPCB和RAMA根据同一评价协议提供互补效益。

blocks.en: Shared-Pattern Collaborative Block (SPCB). Table VIII isolates the Shared Large-Kernel Pattern and Dynamic Kernel Generation while keeping the remaining network, including RAMA, unchanged. The Shared-LK-only and DK-only variants obtain 92.67%, 92.19%, and 93.24%, and 91.13%, 91.62%, and 92.12%, respectively, on Houston2013, Augsburg, and Houston2018. The Shared-LK-only variant is higher than the DK-only variant by 1.54, 0.57, and 1.12 percentage points, indicating a stronger individual contribution of the shared long-range pattern in these experiments. The complete SPCB reaches 93.53%, 92.68%, and 93.77%, outperforming the Shared-LK-only variant by 0.86, 0.49, and 0.53 percentage points and the DK-only variant by 2.40, 1.06, and 1.65 percentage points. To assess input-conditioned filtering, Table VIII replaces the dynamic branch with two static controls of comparable capacity while retaining Shared-LK and the remaining network. Static-DW (generator) feeds a learned constant into the original generator; Static-DW (pointwise) uses a fixed depth-wise kernel with pointwise expansion and projection. Neither consistently improves on Shared-LK only: on Augsburg, OA drops by 0.41 and 0.29 percentage points, respectively, and both remain below Full SPCB on all three datasets. This may reflect the inability of fixed filters to adapt to input structures and their redundant responses with Shared-LK.
blocks.zh: 共享-模式合作区块(SPCB)。 表八隔离了共享的大内核模式和动态内核生成,同时保持了包括RAMA在内的剩余网络不变. 仅限LK和只限DK的变体在休斯敦2013,奥格斯堡和休斯敦2018分别获得92.67%,92.19%和93.24%,91.13%,91.62%和92.12%. 仅限共享-LK的变体比仅限DK的变体高1.54分,0.57分和1.12分,表明这些实验中共享远程模式的个体贡献更强. 完整的SPCB达到93.53%,92.68%,93.77%,比"共享-LK"的变体高0.86,0.49和0.53个百分点,而"DK"的变体高2.40,1.06和1.65个百分点. 为了评估输入条件过滤,表八用两个具有可比较能力的静态控制来取代活性分支,同时保留了共享-LK和所剩网络. 静态-DW(生成器)将一个已学习到的常数输入了原始生成器;静态-DW(正点)使用一个有正点扩展和投影的固定的深入内核. 在Augsburg, OA分别下降了0.41和0.29个百分点,在所有三个数据集中,两者都低于全面SPCB。 这可能反映了固定过滤器无法适应输入结构,以及它们用"共享-LK"的冗余响应.

blocks.en: Region-Adaptive Modality Allocator (RAMA). Table IX compares four fusion strategies with different levels of source-selection adaptivity. 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolution concatenates the features and learns a linear channel mixture, but the same convolutional rule is applied at every spatial location. Global allocator predicts one pair of modality-importance weights from a globally aggregated representation and applies the weights to the entire scene. Regional allocation generates spatially varying allocation maps so that different regions can favor different sources; to isolate the contribution of regional allocation, its final fusion coefficients are fixed to α = β = 0.5 \alpha=\beta=0.5 . Full RAMA combines the regional allocation maps with learnable fusion coefficients, enabling both spatial source selection and adaptive final aggregation.
blocks.zh: 区域-辅助模式分配器(RAMA)。 表九比较了四种聚变策略与不同水平的源选择适配性. 1×1 1\times 1 分解出特征并学习出线性通道混合物,但在每个空间位置适用相同的分解规则. 全球分配器从全球汇总的表述中预测出一对模式重要性权重,并将权重应用于整个场景. 区域分配产生空间相异的分配图,使不同区域能够偏好不同来源;为了隔离区域分配的贡献,其最终的聚变系数被固定为α = β = 0.5\α-ββ= 0.5. 完全RAMA将区域分配图与可学习的聚变系数相结合,使空间源选择和适应性最终聚合成为可能.

blocks.en: The 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolution produces OA values of 91.19%, 90.74%, and 92.58% on Houston2013, Augsburg, and Houston2018, respectively. The global allocator improves the results to 93.53%, 92.26%, and 93.53%, demonstrating the benefit of learning source reliability, although one global weight pair cannot describe all local regions. Regional allocation obtains 93.29%, 92.31%, and 93.63%, showing that spatially varying source selection is useful in Augsburg and Houston2018, although it is slightly lower than the global allocator on Houston2013. Full RAMA achieves 93.53%, 92.68%, and 93.77%, tying the global allocator on Houston2013 and giving the best OA on the other two datasets. Compared with the global allocator, Full RAMA improves OA by 0, 0.42, and 0.24 percentage points, respectively; compared with regional allocation, it improves OA by 0.24, 0.37, and 0.14 percentage points. These results indicate that regional allocation and learnable final aggregation are complementary, yielding the best or tied-best OA across the three datasets.
blocks.zh: 1 × 1 1\times 1 演化出OA值分别为91.19%,90.74%和92.58%,分别位于休斯通2013,奥格斯堡和休斯通2018. 全球分配器将结果提高到93.53%、92.26%和93.53%,显示出学习源可靠性的好处,尽管一个全球重量对无法描述所有地方区域。 区域分配获得93.29%,92.31%,93.63%,表明空间差异的源选择在奥格斯堡和休斯敦2018有用,虽然略低于休斯敦2013年的全球分配器. 完全RAMA实现93.53%,92.68%,93.77%,将全球分配器绑在休斯敦2013上,并在另外两个数据集上给出了最好的OA. 与全球分配器相比,Full RAMA分别改善OA0,0.42和0.24个百分点;与区域分配相比,OA改善0.24,0.37和0.14个百分点. 这些结果表明,区域分配和可学习的最后汇总是相辅相成的,在三个数据集中产生最佳或捆绑最佳的OA。

blocks.en: Shared-Pattern Collaborative Block (SPCB) Sharing Strategy. Table X analyzes the effect of sharing the large-kernel operator across modalities and network depths. Its first row corresponds to an independently parameterized setting in which the large-kernel operators are not shared across modalities or network depths, rather than a setting that removes the large-kernel branch. Without either form of sharing, OA is 90.46%, 91.42%, and 92.28% on Houston2013, Augsburg, and Houston2018, respectively. Cross-modal sharing alone changes these results to 90.52%, 92.26%, and 93.63%, giving gains of 0.06, 0.84, and 1.35 percentage points. Cross-depth sharing alone obtains 91.34%, 91.76%, and 93.33%, improving OA by 0.88, 0.34, and 1.05 percentage points. When both sharing strategies are enabled, OA reaches 93.53%, 92.68%, and 93.77%, exceeding the independently parameterized variant by 3.07, 1.26, and 1.49 percentage points. The combined strategy achieves the highest OA on all three datasets. These results support the complementarity of cross-modal and cross-depth sharing, while the dataset-dependent gains suggest that their relative contributions are not uniform across scenes. On Houston2013, the gain from cross-modal sharing increases from 0.06 to 2.19 percentage points when cross-depth reuse is enabled. Similar paved/built-up classes and narrow roads and railways make spatial structure informative [ 17 ] . Reusing the shared operator across modalities and depths helps retain this geometry as features evolve, while identity channels and dynamic filters preserve early and source-specific cues.
blocks.zh: 共享-模式合作组合共享战略。 页:1 X分析跨模式和网络深度共享大内核操作员的效果. 其一行对应的独立参数化设置,其中大内核操作员不跨模式或网络深度共享,而是一个去除大内核分支的设置. 没有任何形式的共享,OA在休斯通2013,奥格斯堡和休斯通2018分别是90.46%,91.42%和92.28%. 单是跨模式共享就使这些结果变为90.52%、92.26%和93.63%,收益分别为0.06、0.84和1.35个百分点。 单是交叉分享就获得91.34%、91.76%和93.33%,使OA提高了0.88、0.34和1.05个百分点。 当两个共享策略被启用时,OA达到93.53%,92.68%,93.77%,超过了独立参数化的变量3.07,1.26和1.49个百分点. 合并战略在所有三个数据集上实现了最高的OA. 这些结果支持了跨模式和跨深度共享的互补性,而依赖数据集的收益表明,它们之间的相对贡献并不一致。 在休斯敦2013年,跨模式共享的收益在启用跨深度再利用时从0.06个百分点增加到2.19个百分点. 类似的铺设/建造的班级以及狭窄的公路和铁路使空间结构具有了信息性[17]. 利用共享操作员跨模式和深度,有助于随着特性的演化而保留这种几何特征,而身份通道和动态过滤器则保留早期和源特定提示.

blocks.en: IV-E Computational Complexity Analysis
blocks.zh: 四-E 计算复杂性分析

blocks.en: Table XI compares the number of parameters and floating-point operations (FLOPs) of different models. SPCNet contains 1.0893 M parameters and requires 0.2470 GFLOPs. Its parameter count is approximately 97.02% and 94.77% lower than those of FusAtNet and CHNet, respectively, indicating that the proposed modules do not rely on a heavyweight backbone. Although several highly lightweight competitors require less computation, SPCNet still has substantially lower FLOPs than FusAtNet, MACN, and CHNet. With controllable parameter and computational costs, the model achieves the highest overall accuracy (OA) on all three datasets. These results demonstrate that SPCNet achieves a favorable trade-off between accuracy and efficiency.
blocks.zh: 表十一比较了不同模型的参数和浮点操作(FLOP)的数量. SPCNet 包含 1.0893 M参数并需要0.2470 GFLOP. 其参数计数分别比FusAtNet和CHNet低约97.02%和94.77%,表明所拟议的模块不依赖重量级主干. 虽然一些高度轻量级的竞争者需要较少的计算,但SPCNet的FLOP仍然比FusAtNet,MACN和CHNet低得多. 以可控参数和计算成本,该模型在所有三个数据集上都实现了最高的整体精度(OA). 这些结果表明,SPCNet在准确性和效率之间取得了有利的取舍。

blocks.en: IV-F Discussion
blocks.zh: 四-F 讨论

blocks.en: Current experiments use registered multimodal imagery and do not quantify the effect of residual misregistration on cross-modal sharing. Future work can introduce controlled spatial offsets to measure this sensitivity and investigate registration-aware feature alignment to improve robustness.
blocks.zh: 目前的实验使用已登记的多式图象,没有量化残余误登记对跨式共享的影响。 未来的工作可以引入可控空间抵消,以衡量这种敏感性并调查对登记-意识特征的调整,以提高稳健性。

blocks.en: RAMA learns location-wise weights under the classification objective to allocate branch contributions, but the correspondence between these weights and sensor quality remains to be assessed. Future work can introduce controlled modality-specific degradation to examine how allocations respond to changing input quality and develop quality-aware fusion. Although experiments cover three datasets and HSI–LiDAR and HSI–SAR combinations, they are evaluated using dataset-specific training and test splits, leaving their ability to generalize to unseen geographic scenes unexamined. Future work can combine cross-scene evaluation with domain generalization or lightweight adaptation to assess and improve transfer across acquisition conditions.
blocks.zh: RAMA在分级目标下学习位置权重,以分配分支贡献,但这些权重和传感器质量之间的对应关系仍有待评估. 今后的工作可以引入受控模式特有的退化,以审查分配如何对不断变化的投入质量作出反应并发展对质量的认识聚变。 虽然实验包括了三个数据集和HSI-LiDAR和HSI-SAR组合,但使用数据集特有的培训和测试分解来评价这些组合,使得其概括到看不见的地理场景的能力得不到审查. 未来的工作可以将跨场评价与域泛化或轻量级适应相结合,以评估和改善跨获取条件的转让.

blocks.en: V Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 五. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: We proposed SPCNet for multi-source remote sensing data classification. Specifically, the SPCB introduces a shared large-kernel mechanism and dynamic convolution to enhance common spatial-pattern learning while preserving modality-specific representations. Moreover, the RAMA adaptively assigns modality weights for different spatial regions, enabling more effective and reliable cross-modal feature fusion. Experimental results on the Houston2013, Augsburg, and Houston2018 datasets demonstrate that SPCNet achieves superior classification performance compared with several state-of-the-art methods. Future work will investigate more efficient dynamic-kernel generation and evaluate the proposed collaborative learning strategy in broader multi-source remote sensing scenarios.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了多来源遥感数据分类的SPCNet。 具体而言,SPCB引入了共享的大内核机制和动态演进,以加强共同的空间模式学习,同时保留特定模式的表达. 此外,RAMA因地制宜地为不同的空间区域分配了方式权重,从而能够更有效和更可靠的跨模式特性聚变。 休斯通2013号,奥格斯堡号和休斯通2018号数据集的实验结果显示,与几种最先进的方法相比,SPCNet实现了优越的分类性能. 今后的工作将调查更有效率的动态内核生成,并评价在更广泛的多来源遥感情景中拟议的协作学习战略。
